slides.title: A full redesign, a new face
slides.body: New logo, new colors, a refreshed look from top to bottom — the same Ocean Flow, with an identity of its own.

slides.title: Your instructor card
slides.body: My profile now has its own card: professional level, personal data and favorite currency, all in one place.

slides.title: Training Records, right from the app
slides.body: Generate each student's SSI progress record, signed and ready to hand over — without leaving Ocean Flow.

slides.title: The app now speaks your language
slides.body: Spanish, English, French, Italian, German, Catalan or Basque — switch whenever you want, from your profile.

slides.title: Home and My work, clearer than ever
slides.body: Everything better organized, so you can find what you need at a glance: your KPIs, your entries, your day to day.

slides.title: Revisit it whenever you want
slides.body: Find this again from Help → "What's new", any time you like.
